_schema: W12 diff-adjudication registry (user ruling 2026-11-18, GAPS 2.2#12): the sandbox realchain battery performs NO bug adjudication — every divergence is exported to .test-logs/diff-reports/ and matched here. Entry fields: id, scenario_pattern (exact scenario or '*'), state_pattern (optional, default '*'), shape ({kind: substring|regex, ref_contains/rust_contains/any_contains: all must appear in the divergence line, rust_missing/ref_missing: none may appear}), classification (framework-diff|env-artifact|accepted-gap|expected-shape|real-bug|needs-controller), justification, g_ref, adjudicated_by, adjudicated_at, last_observed. Matching is most-specific-first (longest scenario_pattern, then file order); a divergence matched by NO entry = unadjudicated (checker exit 2 = merge gate red). SEMANTIC FORK (review C-1): an expected-shape entry describes the VIOLATION form — a match is a RED in adjudicate.py, and its green channel is the scenario/state report existing without a matching divergence.

Settled grids are EXACT. Shape narrowed (review C-2) to the spinner glyph runs on the interrupt footer row (a run of >=2 ⬝/■ glyphs AND the footer anchor text), not the shared footer text alone.

Mid-stream PARTIAL-prefix phase (review-fix round find): the mid-window capture lands at a different streamed-token offset on each end (same gateway schedule, jittered render clocks) — the partial needle prefix differs by a few chars at the capture instant. Settled grids are EXACT. Same capture-time-race family as w12-midstream-spinner-phase.
t9_5 (single-end): the wide-dock sidebar carries the Context section and its tokens row after a settled reply — expectation present; absence is an UNADJUDICATED red (G-435 family surface).

Load-sensitive plugin MCP settle race (controller adjudication 2026-11-18): under concurrent battery load the rust side's second plugin MCP registers after the settle capture; rerun in isolation shows divergences:0. Historical family: multiple retry-green occurrences since W7 (registered observation in progress.md). Direction-specific — a flipped direction (rust=2/ref=1) would surface as unadjudicated for fresh adjudication.

BOTH ends mishandle the payload differently; candidate real gap (rust column accounting for wide/ZWJ clusters). Controller to register.

Retry-scheduling display is a known B-family GAP; the provider-label difference is a fresh real diff. Controller to adjudicate.

Reproduced 3/3 rig builds (battery + record lane). Candidate real bug in the plugin-loaded send path (plugin skill/agent injection blocking the model call on rust). Controller to register/escalate.
